title: INTERNAL MEMO — PROVOST FARX
author: Provost H. Farx
content:
INTERNAL MEMORANDUM
Priority: ELEVATED
From: Provost H. Farx, Torpol Port Authority
To: All Administrative Staff (Level 3+)
Timestamp: 32 Hours Ago

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Reputation containment is PRIORITY ONE.

The media narrative must emphasize mechanical
malfunction pending formal investigation. Under no
circumstances is the word "pirate" or any derivative
terminology to be used in public-facing channels,
press communications, or civilian-accessible systems.

All external enquiries are to be directed to my
office. I will personally oversee recovery efforts
and coordinate with orbital traffic control.

I remind all staff that Torpol's tourism index is
currently at a five-year high. A single piracy
incident — real or perceived — would trigger
immediate Travellers' Aid Society review and
potential downgrade of our safe harbour rating.

Success in containing this matter could set a
precedent for further administrative advancement
for those involved.

I trust I have made myself clear.

    — Provost H. Farx
    — Torpol Port Authority
    — Office of the Polar Port Administrator
